{{Top|leg}}
'''Bulky Exploratory Armor''' was designed to operate in harsh weather or [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] conditions. Rarely worn by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], the BEA had an integrated [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]] and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] cylinders. It could also be employed in place of a standard [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] for EVA work. The BEA had removable weight boots with [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] soles, and was equipped with tool and [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]]. The helmets had inbuilt [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Glowrod/Legends|flashlights]].
